body.body: Baseline replication of ?source-paper — re-run the headline result on the canonical dataset, no hyperparameter change, to confirm reproducibility before any new variant is built on top.
Ablation of ?source-paper hypothesis — knock out the single mechanism the paper claims is load-bearing and confirm headline metric drops by a non-trivial margin.
Axis extension of ?source-paper — take the principal axis the paper varies and probe one neighbouring axis (different bucket, different horizon, different ticker pool) to test the claim's transfer.
